name: tutti.ch – giveaways / free items, Kanton St. Gallen
geographic_relevance: High – location filter geo-canton-st-gallen / geo-city-st-gallen (+radius) verified server-side
data_available: Classified listings: id, title, body, formattedPrice ('Gratis' for free), timestamp, postcode/locality/canton, category, thumbnail, seller alias
endpoints: GET https://www.tutti.ch/de/q/st-gallen/Ak6ZncmF0aXPAlMDAwJGTqGxvY2F0aW9utGdlby1jYW50b24tc3QtZ2FsbGVuwA  (query 'gratis', canton SG: totalCount 4709, 6/30 Gratis on p1)
GET https://www.tutti.ch/de/q/st-gallen/Ak8DAlMDAwJGTqGxvY2F0aW9usmdlby1jaXR5LXN0LWdhbGxlbsA (all listings city St. Gallen, 26,476) – optional newest-first scan with client-side Gratis filter
robots: Allowed for /de/q/ and /de/vi/ (User-agent *). Disallowed: /api/, /de/li/, /de/listings, /de/user, /de/start, /de/messages, /aw, /pg … (GraphQL /api/v10/graphql is therefore OFF-LIMITS).
constraints: Data read only from server-rendered __NEXT_DATA__ of public search pages. No public API; GraphQL under /api/ is robots-disallowed. Search token format is undocumented and may change. Respect 1 req/s.
publication_frequency: Continuous; dozens of new free-item listings per day in canton SG (page 1 of 'verschenken' spans ~2 days)
offer_duration: Listings live up to 60 days, but free items are typically taken within hours–2 days
pagination: ?page=N on canonical slug URL, 30 items/page, newest first (verified page=2 returns different items)
status_reason: Real listings retrieved with our UA (200), parser tested; free-only server filter not encodable -> keyword queries + post-filter
recommended_poll: Every 20–30 min: page 1 of 2–3 keyword tokens ('verschenken','gratis','zu verschenken') = 3 req/run
notes: tutti and anibis run on the same SMG Next.js platform (identical robots.txt and token format) but return separate inventories (tutti IDs 8xxxxxxx source 'tutti'; anibis IDs 107xxxxxxx source 'anibis'). Browser UA gave identical 200 response => no UA-based blocking. Full keyword coverage: 'verschenken' 13 pages, 'gratis' 157 pages (not needed – newest page suffices).

parser_spec.container: HTML <script id="__NEXT_DATA__"> JSON -> props.pageProps.dehydratedState.queries[0].state.data.listings (totalCount, edges[]). 30 edges/page, sorted newest first by default.

per_item(node=edge.node).title: node.localization.title
per_item(node=edge.node).price: node.formattedPrice: 'Gratis' -> 0.0; '600.-' / "1'200.-" -> strip "'" then float(digits); 'Auf Anfrage' or other text -> null
per_item(node=edge.node).condition: not in search payload (only in body text / detail page)
per_item(node=edge.node).seller: node.sellerInfo.alias (do not store personal data beyond need)

parser_spec.free_detection: formattedPrice=='Gratis' (tutti 'verschenken' canton SG page1: 21/30 Gratis; anibis 'gratis' canton SG page1: 3/30) plus optional title regex (gratis|verschenk|zu verschenken)
parser_spec.token_spec: Search token = 'A' + base64url_nopad(msgpack([query_or_None, categoryID_or_None, [strings, prices, intervals, locations]])). Verified working: locations=[['location','geo-canton-st-gallen',None]] (169,198 listings), ['location','geo-city-st-gallen',None] (26,476), radius km as 3rd element e.g. ['location','geo-city-st-gallen',10] (67,285). Free-only (priceFilter.freeOnly) could NOT be encoded (6 variants tried, all rejected -> redirect to default token), so use text queries + post-filter formattedPrice=='Gratis'. Python: 'A'+base64.urlsafe_b64encode(msgpack.packb(['verschenken',None,[None,None,None,[['location','geo-canton-st-gallen',None]]]])).decode().rstrip('=') == 'Ak6t2ZXJzY2hlbmtlbsCUwMDAkZOobG9jYXRpb260Z2VvLWNhbnRvbi1zdC1nYWxsZW7A'. Use the canonical slug path /de/q/st-gallen/<token>?page=N (with a non-canonical slug the server 301s to the canonical URL and DROPS ?page).
